rows.description: 书童 Pagekin（原名 AI 小说作家）：开源免费的 AI 长篇小说写作桌面软件，从设定、蓝图到正文、审稿、定稿；支持拆解仿写、续写、改写，可导入写作 Skill（如去 AI 味）。模型需自行配置，作品在本地。Pagekin (formerly AI Novel Writer): free, open-source AI novel writing app for long novels and web fiction. Imitate, continue, rewrite; import writing skills. Local-first, no model bundled. Windows & macOS.

Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode agent skills for writing Chinese web novels (网文): 扫榜、拆文、写作、去AI味、封面全流程，长篇短篇都支持 | 14 skills for novel writing and long-form fiction with file-based continuity tracking. MIT.
专为小说创作打造的跨平台、用户友好、AI Native 的一站式 Vibe Writing 工具。A cross-platform, user-friendly, AI-native, all-in-one Vibe Writing tool designed specifically for novel writing.
